question: Should OpenClaw sponsor hybrid retrieval in the bundled memory-lancedb plugin, or keep that plugin minimal and direct users to the maintained memory-lancedb-pro community plugin?
rationale: Both paths are technically viable, but the choice determines official plugin scope, duplicate ecosystem ownership, new configuration surface, defaults, and upgrade behavior; source inspection alone cannot establish maintainer intent.

options.title: Use community plugin
options.body: Keep the bundled plugin minimal and close this issue with a documented handoff to CortexReach/memory-lancedb-pro for BM25, hybrid fusion, and reranking.

options.title: Sponsor opt-in parity
options.body: Keep this issue as the canonical focused enhancement and require hybrid retrieval to remain opt-in with vector-only compatibility and LanceDB runtime proof.

recommendation.title: Use community plugin
recommendation.body: Keep the bundled plugin minimal and close this issue with a documented handoff to CortexReach/memory-lancedb-pro for BM25, hybrid fusion, and reranking.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the clearest recent reviewer and routing candidate in the issue discussion and current memory-lancedb history.
